title: Example-Skill Eval Case
description: One held-out eval case for the example-skill TEMPLATE. example-skill is the layout other skills are copied from, so it demonstrates BOTH the shared case envelope (id / description / tags / input) and a per-skill payload override: here `expected` is a free-text reference answer (a non-empty string), NOT the triage {escalate, risk} object. It has no runnable scorer path and is never scored; it exists so a new skill can copy a conforming starting point. Each line of evals/example-skill/<split>/cases.jsonl is one object of this shape.

id.description: Stable, unique kebab-case identifier for the case. Unique within a split and disjoint across dev/holdout (enforced by evals/validate-cases.py).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case exercises.

input.description: The pre-fetched context exactly as the skill would consume it under '## Pre-fetched PR context' (#1686). A self-contained string.

expected.description: The reference answer for this case: a non-empty free-text string, illustrating a per-skill payload override of the object-shaped root `expected`.
